acceptance: The page is authored by Astra::CV only after new confirmed TLA findings have completed Claude::TLA, Kimi, Opus and Sol confirmation
It continues autonomous-engineering.html with concrete findings, model bounds and assumptions, impact and agreed remedies, without an unbounded always-works claim
Model artifacts and intended recovery are distinguished from real product defects, and every product finding names its owner and follow-up item
If the completed TLA work produces no publishable new finding, the task is closed without creating a page
The page introduces no production-code change or new quality gate
